nodes.label: XP Gain by Action
nodes.rationale: Weights are skewed toward selling (+20) and trading (+15) over passive production (+5) to steer players into the trading economy. Build/upgrade XP is cost x 0.001 capped at 1,000 so late-game spend does not explode XP.

nodes.label: Level-Up Requirement Formula (100 x N^2.2)
nodes.rationale: N^2.2 is steeper than N^2 in the late game specifically to suppress high-level inflation. There is no daily XP cap — farming is instead controlled by the formula's caps and the fraud-prevention logic.

nodes.label: Level Unlock Gates (Lv.1/5/10/25/40/50)
nodes.rationale: Uniform scheme adopted 2026-07-03: T1 (incl. oil well) Lv.1 / all T2 Lv.5 / all T3 Lv.10, completing the 11-factory roster. The staggered alternative is deferred as a tuning option until the balance simulator provides evidence.
